idea: Make codex-engine ralph members run NON-degraded multi-lens brainstorm/review by extending the EXISTING harness-aware tool-mention seam (the build-time generate-copilot-artifacts.mjs generator) to a third harness (codex), emitting codex's native spawn_agent/followup_task/wait_agent/list_agents plus when-to-delegate guidance instead of Claude Task / Copilot task. Operator-directed; NOT a bespoke runtime adapter. Use only the codex 0.135 surface.

missingLenses.reason: deliberately skipped for resource-safety: copilot-exec --read-only byte-snapshots both submodule trees into memory; concurrent runs are the likely r1/r2 resource-death cause, and the product/adoption lens is least decision-relevant for an internal-tooling plumbing change

candidateDirections.summary: Add a third (codex) target to ralph-orchestration's build-time generator that lowers one Agent() call into a spawn->followup_task->wait_agent->collect->validate-JSON->close recipe with fail-hard handling + injected when-to-delegate guidance; plugin-side only, target v2, gated on D-003.

candidateDirections.name: Engine-neutral delegation macro/helper expanded per harness, with per-engine contract tests

candidateDirections.name: Disposable multi_agent_v2=true result-retrieval spike before any generator change (prerequisite gate)
candidateDirections.summary: Cheaply validate the single load-bearing unknown: can a parent codex 0.135 v2 member spawn 2-3 children, wait, retrieve each FULL final answer as JSON using only model-visible tools, handle one timeout by failing hard, and close them? Go/no-go gate for D-001.

candidateDirections.name: Keep codex out of Ralph orchestration; treat it as target-runtime + specialist worker only (null option)
candidateDirections.summary: Run Ralph fan-out under Claude/Copilot (which already provide the synchronous contract) and spawn codex only for codex-specific execution; pursue quality parity, not native per-engine phase parity. Preserves a visible degraded gap but avoids async/v1-v2/orphan-cleanup/drift complexity.

candidateDirections.name: Hand-author codex skill/agent variants beside Claude/Copilot (stopgap)
candidateDirections.summary: Fastest path to some codex multi-lens for narrow brainstorm/review skills without touching the generator, but creates immediate parity drift with no generator gate; rejected if more than a couple of fan-out sites exist.

questionsForSynthesis: Can codex 0.135 expose each child's FULL final answer to the parent through model-visible tools (list_agents / message stream), or does reliable collection require app-server/event-stream code outside the prompt? (gating unknown -> D-003)
v1 vs v2 target: ship v2-only (features.multi_agent_v2=true, cleaner followup_task/list_agents) coordinated with codex-engine-ralph-member-enablement, or also support stock v1?
Where is features.multi_agent_v2 set and verified for spawned codex Ralph members (happy-cli buildThreadConfig() vs ~/.codex/config.toml)?
Will generated Ralph instructions count as the explicit user request that codex v1's spawn gate requires, or must the design mandate v2 to escape v1's suppression?
On child timeout / malformed JSON / task-name collision / orphaned agents: fail the Ralph phase, retry, or allow partial synthesis? (the recipe must specify fail-hard vs mark-missing)

Should the generator stay a per-target regex translator (D-001) or graduate to an engine-neutral delegation macro with contract tests (D-002), and can the canonical Claude source tolerate macro syntax without losing plain-markdown readability?
